input_messages.content: Hi there! I just received my order and I’m really upset about the quality of the two skateboards I bought. I’d like to return them and get a refund to my credit card. Can you help me with that?
I actually don’t remember which email I used for this order, but my name is Mei Ahmed and my zip code is 78705. Will that work?
I’m not sure what the order ID is off the top of my head. Can you help me find it? I just got the delivery recently, if that helps.
Before we go ahead, I also want to return the smart watch from the same order. Can I include that in the return as well?

Yes, that all looks correct! Please go ahead and process the returns and the exchange for me. Thank you!

That’s perfect, thanks so much for your help! I appreciate it. Have a great day!
